T: The theme park ride from hell.
D: Axel tracks a counterfeiting ring to a Southern California theme park.
P: Serve the snacks when the Spider ride gets stuck.
S: Popcorn coated in a brown sugar and golden syrup caramel
Popcorn tossed in brown sugar caramel with a pinch of bicarb, baked at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15.
Theme park churros with chocolate dip

Choux dough piped in long ridged lengths, fried crisp and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick hot chocolate dipping sauce. Bring 250ml water, 50g butter, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour, cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and stir in 150g dark chocolate for the dip.
Franks on sticks dipped in cornmeal batter and fried

Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep gold. Serve with mustard.
M: Uncle Dave's theme park turkey legs
Drumsticks brined overnight, rubbed with paprika, roasted until falling off the bone

Turkey drumsticks brined overnight in salt, brown sugar and smoked paprika, smoked or roasted at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls from the bone. Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water with 1 tbsp smoked paprika. Brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry, rub with more paprika and roast at 150C for 2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.
Axel's home town, crispy cheese edges and all

Thick airy dough baked in an oiled tin with cheese right to the edges for lacy crisp corners, pepperoni underneath and rich tomato sauce striped on top. Mix 400g bread flour, 300ml warm water, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil into a wet dough and prove 2 hours. Press into a well-oiled 23 by 33cm tin and prove 30 minutes. Lay 100g pepperoni over, then 350g cubed mozzarella and cheddar mixed, pushing it hard against the tin edges. Bake at 250C for 15 minutes until the edges are dark and crisp. Spoon 250ml warm passata cooked with garlic and oregano in two stripes on top.
W: Apples dipped in red hard toffee, served with a bag of cotton candy
Toffee apples: sugar, water and a splash of vinegar boiled to 150C, red colouring, apples dipped and set. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: Blue raspberry cordial, lemonade and lime blended with ice, no alcohol

Blue raspberry syrup blitzed with lemonade, lime and plenty of ice until slushy, poured tall with a striped straw and a few frozen raspberries. Add 120ml blue raspberry cordial, 400ml lemonade, the juice of 1 lime and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blitz in short bursts for 30 seconds until fine and slushy, adding more ice if it's thin. Drop a few frozen raspberries into 4 tall glasses, pour the slushie over and serve with straws straight away.

veg.n: Uncle Dave's theme park smoky mushroom legs

steps.text: Dissolve the salt and sugar in the water with some of the paprika.
Brine the mushrooms for 1 hour.
Pat dry, push a skewer up through each stem and rub with the oil and the rest of the paprika.
Roast at 200C, turning once, until deeply browned and tender.
